Wildlife trafficking is a global crisis where illegal trade threatens biodiversity and threatens species survival. • Products packaged in suspicious containers or containers that don't match the species on display
• Communication from individuals claiming to be buyers or sellers who aren't licensed
• Documentation that lacks proper identification stamps

2. Report the activity to authorities (CITES office in your country, local police, or your embassy)

**CITES** and International Oversight

CITES (the World Trade Organization Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora) sets global standards for protecting wildlife. Reporting through CITES ensures coordinated action by member countries.
